pair_prompt.title: Reason About the Last Valid Index
pair_prompt.prompt_text: Ask the driver to explain why array.length is the number of elements and what the last valid index should be for the current array.

peer_review_prompt.title: Review the Array Access Fix
peer_review_prompt.prompt_text: Check whether the fix uses a safe array index and whether the explanation clearly distinguishes array length from the last valid index.

pair_prompt.title: Trace the Final Loop Iteration
pair_prompt.prompt_text: Have the driver trace the final loop iteration aloud and compare the stopping condition with the last valid array index.

peer_review_prompt.title: Review the Loop Boundary Choice
peer_review_prompt.prompt_text: Review whether the stopping condition avoids one extra iteration and whether the explanation matches the valid index range.

pair_prompt.title: Explain the Condition in Plain English
pair_prompt.prompt_text: Ask the driver to read the condition in plain English and explain whether it is checking a value or accidentally assigning one.

peer_review_prompt.title: Review the Conditional Operator
peer_review_prompt.prompt_text: Check whether the condition uses the correct operator and whether the reviewer comment explains why that operator is appropriate.

pair_prompt.title: Explain Reference vs Content Equality
pair_prompt.prompt_text: Ask the driver to explain what == compares for two String variables and how that differs from what .equals() checks.

peer_review_prompt.title: Review the String Comparison Fix
peer_review_prompt.prompt_text: Check whether the fix uses .equals() for string content and whether the explanation covers why == was wrong here.

pair_prompt.title: Trace the Counter Direction
pair_prompt.prompt_text: Have the driver write the counter value for the first three iterations and say whether it moves toward the loop bound.

peer_review_prompt.title: Review the Loop Update Fix
peer_review_prompt.prompt_text: Review whether the update step now moves the counter toward the stopping condition and whether the trace supports it.

pair_prompt.title: Find Where the Method Ends
pair_prompt.prompt_text: Ask the driver to trace the method aloud and point to the exact line where execution leaves it, then say which lines can never run.

peer_review_prompt.title: Review the Statement Order
peer_review_prompt.prompt_text: Check whether all needed statements now run before the return and whether any dead code remains after it.

pair_prompt.title: Walk One Value Through the Switch
pair_prompt.prompt_text: Have the driver pick one input value and list every statement the switch runs for it, including any fall-through.

peer_review_prompt.title: Review the Break Placement
peer_review_prompt.prompt_text: Review whether each case now ends where intended and whether any remaining fall-through is deliberate and commented.

pair_prompt.title: Say What the Condition Controls
pair_prompt.prompt_text: Ask the driver to state exactly which statement the if controls, then look at the first character after the closing parenthesis.

peer_review_prompt.title: Review the Statement Structure
peer_review_prompt.prompt_text: Check whether the stray semicolon is gone and the block below now belongs to the condition as intended.

pair_prompt.title: Read the Assignment Right to Left
pair_prompt.prompt_text: Ask the driver to read the assignment from right to left and state what the variable holds before and after the line runs.

peer_review_prompt.title: Review the Assignment Fix
peer_review_prompt.prompt_text: Review whether the assignment now uses the intended source value and actually changes the program state.

pair_prompt.title: Test the Condition with Sample Values
pair_prompt.prompt_text: Have the driver pick three sample values and evaluate the whole condition for each, checking whether it can ever be false.

peer_review_prompt.title: Review the Boolean Operator Choice
peer_review_prompt.prompt_text: Check whether the corrected condition uses && or || to match the intended meaning and rejects the right values.

pair_prompt.title: Follow the Returned String
pair_prompt.prompt_text: Ask the driver where the new string returned by this method call goes, and what the original variable holds afterwards.

peer_review_prompt.title: Review the String Result Handling
peer_review_prompt.prompt_text: Review whether the method result is now assigned and used, and whether the explanation mentions string immutability.

pair_prompt.title: Check Every Divisor
pair_prompt.prompt_text: Ask the driver to circle each divisor in the expression and explain what happens if any of them is zero at runtime.

peer_review_prompt.title: Review the Division Guard
peer_review_prompt.prompt_text: Check whether the divisor is now correct or guarded, and whether the fix handles the zero case sensibly.

pair_prompt.title: Evaluate the First Condition Check
pair_prompt.prompt_text: Have the driver plug the loop's starting value into the condition and say whether the body runs even once.

peer_review_prompt.title: Review the Loop Range
peer_review_prompt.prompt_text: Review whether the start value and bound now describe the intended range and the loop runs the expected number of times.

pair_prompt.title: Find What Changes the Condition
pair_prompt.prompt_text: Ask the driver to underline the variables in the while condition and point to the line inside the loop that changes any of them.

peer_review_prompt.title: Review the Loop Exit
peer_review_prompt.prompt_text: Check whether the loop body now updates a condition variable so the loop is guaranteed to finish.
